name: Generate topic document
description: Creates the standardized Word document for one already-approved topic and files it in the caller's interview folder. The summary text is read from Dataverse, never from the caller, so save_topic_summary must have stored it first; pass only the topic order. Also ensures the Source transcripts/ and Supporting documents/ subfolders, files a Markdown source transcript under Source transcripts/, and lists the actual contents of Supporting documents/ in a closing section. Returns the .docx as a file attachment. Reruns best-effort replace the canonical generated .docx; if SharePoint cannot delete that existing file, the new document is filed with a deterministic -FINAL suffix. Reruns never touch user-supplied supporting files. Use this instead of building or uploading a topic .docx yourself.

inputFields.label: Topic order
inputFields.description: The order number of the topic whose document should be generated, taken verbatim from the last state (e.g. 2). Everything else — the summary text, file name, folder path, and interview — is resolved server-side. A topic without an approved stored summary is refused with a conflict and nothing is written.
